3558-4050-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-4050-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding one mana of any color
Repeat.

751-3286-4460.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

193-1124-2724-8172.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

3899-4231-4321-5270-5682.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Astrid
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5226-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-7487-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-7487-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Zealous Lorecaster without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Zealous Lorecaster) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-7487-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

443-1263-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

206-215-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
206-215-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-6965-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-6965-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-5570-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Nardole enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Nardole enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

757-2872-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

774-5033-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
774-5033-6763.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Storm Cauldron triggers twice, returning both lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

997-5170-5933-6132.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

4875-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying {3}{W}.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it triggers, blinking itself as it isn't an Assassin due to Conspiracy.
Repeat step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1887-2963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-2963-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

304-1978-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
304-1978-4002.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Tough Cookie.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

1399-1458-1825-3400.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to four lands excluding Wirewood Lodge that can tap to produce at least {G}{U}{U}.
You control an Elf that does not have summoning sickness.
1399-1458-1825-3400.description:
Activate Wirewood Lodge and up to four other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {C}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting an Elf you control without summoning sickness.
Cast Treachery by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting a creature other than Ivy.
Ivy triggers, copying the Treachery spell, with the copy targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of the Treachery spell, creating a copy of Treachery attached to Ivy.
When the Treachery token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to four lands excluding Wirewood Lodge by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}{U}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping the Elf.
Resolve the original Treachery spell.
When Treachery enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate the Elf by tapping it, returning the nontoken Treachery from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Wirewood Lodge and up to four other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {C}{G}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-6471-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Will of the Temur
2743-6471-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Will of the Temur twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Will of the Temurs, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

4067-5672-6479.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4659-5361-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
4659-5361-5365.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and Auton Soldier's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
4659-5361-5365.notes:
You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

3995-4188-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3995-4188-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Accomplished Alchemist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2178-4170-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4170-4871-5686.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

774-2653-3861.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

618-2178-3595.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Shambling Shell with haste.
Activate the Shambling Shell token by sacrificing it.
When the Shambling Shell token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Shambling Shell ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
Repeat.

2232-2440-3433-4055.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio, and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Cloudstone Curio each trigger four times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hornet Queen from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {5} for each Insect you control.
Activate Energy Refractor three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2947-4089-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Glasspool Mimic's power.
Repeat.

770-974-2472.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
770-974-2472.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
Song of the Worldsoul triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
When Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may use Song of the Worldsoul's trigger to target any other token you control instead.

2776-2816-5089.notablePrerequisites: Doubling Cube does not have summoning sickness.
2776-2816-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Doubling Cube to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Doubling Cube.
Float at least {10} in your mana pool.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {7}.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

231-661-1119-3390.description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Tree of Tales.
Activate Sculpting Steel by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Sculpting Steel from the battlefield to your hand.
If it has not triggered this turn, Tameshi's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Tameshi's second ability, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

851-4152-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Undercity Scrounger.
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
851-4152-4222.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.

618-1110-4831.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Cacophodon with haste.
The Cacophodon token enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing damage to the Cacophodon token equal to its power.
The Cacophodon token triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

326-2522.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Witherbloom Apprentice triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Chain of Smog, discarding two cards and choosing to copy it, targeting yourself with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

2358-2656-3260-4457.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying three life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or less life.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each player's life total to become equal to the lowest life total among all players.
Cast Blood Tithe by paying {3}{B}, causing each opponent to lose three life and gaining you life equal to life lost this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
